list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own — it is the reward for the whole list, not a task of its own. Follow the roadmap in order (story, strangers, activities, collectibles, cleanup) so nothing is left for the end. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first mission of the game, so it pops early in a first playthrough. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed, so finish it properly the first time. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Nothing in a chapter trophy needs a special approach — just play the story through. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Play the story in order and it comes on its own. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. No side task is needed for a chapter trophy. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. It is the last chapter trophy before the finale. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Play the final mission of the story to its end — this gold trophy is the story's closing beat. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed, so do not rush the finale; finish the stranger strands and open-world trophies you care about first. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It pops when the mission ends, with no extra condition attached. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed, so complete it cleanly the first time. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. The trophy is for finishing the mission, not for how you do it. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy pops at the mission's end. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. The trophy pops when the mission ends. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's own checklist (target: 100%). Open the in-game progress screen and work through what it still lists — story, strangers, activities and collectibles all feed it. This is the long grind of the platinum, so leave it for the cleanup stage. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida (target: 250). Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime moments the game counts as you drive and ride — they add up across the whole playthrough, so keep playing naturally and check your count as you go. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once (target: 9). The game counts a type when you first play it, so sample everything on offer — races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest — rather than grinding one. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (target: 42). Work through the range's challenge list one at a time and repeat any challenge that lands below gold until it clears. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (target: 14). A location counts once you have won its race, so visit each drone-race spot in turn and win there. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races (target: 20). Only distinct races count, so winning the same race again adds nothing — spread your wins across the race list. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take Cal on in one of the game's fishing challenges and out-fish him — the trophy is for the win, not for the catch alone. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Find an arcade cabinet in the world, pick a game and see it through to its end. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Andy's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you meet people across Leonida — keep returning to Andy until his last mission appears. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play Kenton's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Follow the strand's missions in order until Kenton's last one opens. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play Billy's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Keep following Billy's missions until the last one appears. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida (target: 8). A strand counts when its missions are all done, so finish whole strands rather than starting many — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play Randy's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Follow Randy's missions in order until the last one opens. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Tyrone's stranger strand through to its final mission and complete it. Keep following Tyrone's missions until the last one appears. Missable: it is one-chance only if GTA VI has no mission replay — that is not yet confirmed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida (target: 18). Visit each meditation spot and meditate there; a spot counts once you have done it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. This belongs to Bret's stranger strand — follow his missions until he sets the hunt, then take down the animal he names. The description names no animal or place, so no specific target is verified yet. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets (target: 3). Collect the cards scattered across Leonida and finish three full sets — a set counts only when every card in it is found. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations (target: 100). Use the WAiNK feature at a hundred different spots around Leonida — each location counts once, so keep moving to new places rather than repeating one. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges (target: 50). The game's challenge list tracks dozens of small feats across driving, combat and exploration — work through the ones you are closest to and the count climbs steadily. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the police and escape. The trophy needs your partner present for the whole escape — do not split up before the heat is off. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Plan a short route between three shops, keep the wanted level alive between them, and do not let it drop before the third robbery. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles (target: 100). The game counts a vehicle when you first find and drive it, so try every new car, bike and truck you come across instead of sticking to one favourite. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with five or more enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). The description names the airport, not the vehicle or the gate, so no specific step is verified yet — head to VCIA and leave by a departure that is not a scheduled one. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet. The official description is a joke — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and names no location, no step and no count, and no guide has verified how this one pops. Do not trust any claimed method until Exophase or PSNProfiles confirms it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan the robbery so no camera, guard or witness spots you — the trophy fails the moment you are seen, so go quiet and leave before the alarm. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape (target: 5). Each vault counts only if you get away after it, so treat the escape as part of the job — plan your exit before you crack the vault. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop the truck, take its cargo and get away — the escape is part of the trophy, so do not linger at the scene. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida (target: 52). Travel into every corner of the map — an area counts once you have been there, so use the in-game map to spot the places you have not visited. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (target: 9). Find one operation per gang and hit it — the trophy needs all nine gangs covered, not nine hits on the same gang. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet. The description names Ocean Beach and a cocktail, but no bar, no spot and no exact step has been verified, and no guide has confirmed how this one pops. Do not trust any claimed method until Exophase or PSNProfiles confirms it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a vehicle inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the glass — the trophy is for the exit, so make it loud and make it through. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go to that bowling alley, play a game and follow your throw through — the trophy names the venue, so play there rather than anywhere else. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet. The official description is a riddle — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — and names no person, no place and no step, and no guide has verified how this one pops. Do not trust any claimed method until Exophase or PSNProfiles confirms it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices as you play — PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 (target: 500). The description gives no list of which choices count, so no specific route is verified yet; keep choosing as the story and side content offer options and the count climbs. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet. The official description is a riddle — 'Second time's the charm' — and names no activity, no place and no step, and no guide has verified how this one pops. Do not trust any claimed method until Exophase or PSNProfiles confirms it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: No verified method exists yet. The official description is a reaction — 'What the hell just happened?' — and names no event, no place and no step, and no guide has verified how this one pops. Do not trust any claimed method until Exophase or PSNProfiles confirms it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a person on foot and strike them with a melee attack from the vehicle — the trophy is for the drive-by hit, not for a crash. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts (target: $250,000). Turn marked bills into clean money via your contacts and let the total build — it is a money total, not a single job. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops (target: $100,000). Buy gear, clothes, weapons and anything else the shops sell — the total counts across every shop, so normal spending adds up. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties (target: 8). Buy every garage on the property market — a garage counts once you own it, so work through the list until all eight are yours. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app (target: 10). Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone and register ten different vehicles to it — each vehicle counts once. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophies page.
trophies.name: On the Spot
